dash.help.07: Requests without this token are rejected with a 401 error, preventing anyone on the same Wi-Fi from reading or writing state. When running the server (npm run server), set the POMODORO_TOKEN environment variable to this exact value to enable communication.
dash.help.19: Restoring reverts data to the selected point and automatically restarts the app. This action is irreversible. If you might need your current data, click "Back up now" first to save the current state.
dash.help.12: Signing in here automatically disables the Wi-Fi (local network) channel above, as cloud takes over paths that may disconnect due to firewall or router differences. The shared folder (e.g., iCloud) channel continues to operate alongside it.
dash.help.02: Focus starts automatically when you sit down. Once started, Pause and Stop buttons disappear. The session continues even if you leave, running until the timer ends. Breaks cannot be skipped, even in strict Lock mode. If the app quits, it automatically restarts within 30 seconds. You can only turn this option off after the current session ends (when idle). This mode prevents the habit of quitting Pomodoro every time.
dash.help.17: Manage the class Pomodoro block in Class Reminder's calendar settings. When enabled, focus pauses during class and new starts or resumes are blocked. Break locking stays active.
dash.help.13: If two devices are running independently, the remaining time is synchronized to the shorter one (so the break time is not delayed).
dash.help.15: This is an additional channel separate from the Wi-Fi/shared folder sync above. Existing sync works without login. If you sign in with an account, timer state is also shared with the "Report Hub" app on iPhone using the same account (the same account used in Four Seasons Log).
dash.help.18: Automatically saves app data (Settings, Log, timer state) to the PomodoroSync/Backups folder in Google Drive daily. It does not upload duplicates if restarted within 20 hours. It automatically skips days where data decreases abnormally (e.g., >30% drop) to avoid overwriting with corrupted data. Only the last 14 backups are kept.
dash.help.10: If the remaining time displayed on screen differs between devices despite having the same endsAt, it is usually because one device's system clock is out of sync with actual time (real incident, 2026-08-04). Even with automatic time setting enabled, clocks can drift by seconds. Therefore, it directly compares time every 30 minutes and shares results with other devices.
dash.help.04: During the specified days and times, a full-screen break window appears regardless of the Focus/Break cycle, preventing computer use. (If "Lock screen during Break" is enabled in Settings > Break, the macOS lock screen is also engaged.) Each segment can be up to 7 hours long.
dash.help.08: Clicking "Auto-detect Google Drive" finds the actual Google Drive mount (~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-…) and connects directly to the PomodoroSync folder inside it. Do not manually select folders named "Google Drive" on the Desktop etc., as they are often fake folders not actually uploaded to the cloud (real incident, 2026-07-29).
dash.help.05: Use natural language to control the timer and set a daily limit for desktop AI apps. For example: "Start 25 minutes of Focus", "Set Focus to 50 minutes", "Limit AI apps to 2 hours a day and track only ChatGPT and Claude", or "Unlock for 24 hours". iPhone Screen Time app selection is configured separately on the iPhone.
dash.help.06: e.g.: `22:00~07:00 lock mode`, `Unlock lock mode for 24 hours from now`, `Excluded apps: Phone, YouTube Music`
dash.help.09: You can also manually select other cloud folders like iCloud Drive, OneDrive, or Dropbox using "Find file path". If both Mac and Windows point to the same folder, timer, settings, and log are shared.
dash.help.03: Compact mode shows only a circular ring. Click it to reveal the time, phase, today's total, and controls.
dash.help.01: When enabled, "Skip" and "Hide" buttons disappear from the break screen. It covers the entire screen (including the menu bar) and immediately returns to the front if you switch windows—there is no way to bypass it until the break ends.
dash.help.11: Even if Mac and Windows are not on the same Wi-Fi, they exchange timer state every 10 seconds. Just enter the same Username and PIN (4 digits) on both devices. If you don't have an account, one is created automatically upon first login.
dash.help.14: Syncing in real time with account.
